verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server at https://cloud.typesense.org/mcp/v1, with a ready-made `claude mcp add --transport http` setup command. Through it an agent can create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics. Users choose what the agent may do when connecting and can disconnect at any time. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and evidence of MCP support for self-hosted open-source deployments (the documented server is Typesense Cloud only).
